defs.def: a piece of paper that shows how much you owe sb for goods or services 账单

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在殖民地其他地方以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛使用。

ex.s: Tobacco was used as coins or paper bills in American in the past.
ex.t: 过去在美国，烟草曾被当作硬币或纸币使用。

ex.s: Duck-billed platypus: The first scientists to examine a preserved platypus body judged it a fake in the late 18th century.
ex.t: 鸭嘴兽：最早检查一只保存完好的鸭嘴兽标本的科学家在18世纪末判定它是一个伪造品。

ex.s: Zeng Zi b Procrastination is like a credit card: it’s a lot of fun until you get the bill.
ex.t: 曾子 b 拖延症就像一张信用卡：在收到账单之前其乐无穷。

ex.s: Because I contribute to the household bills and my commute to work is quite expensive, I find it hard to save any money.
ex.t: 因为我需要分担家庭账单，而且我的通勤费用相当昂贵，所以我发现很难存下钱。

ex.s: Jennifer received great support from her family as she worked to earn her degree: Her husband worked two jobs to cover the bills, and her 68-year-old mother helped take care of the children at times.
ex.t: 珍妮弗在努力攻读学位的过程中得到了家人的大力支持：她的丈夫打两份工来支付账单她68岁的母亲有时帮忙照看孩子。

defs.def: a piece of paper that shows how much you have to pay for the food and drinks that you have had in a restaurant （餐馆的）账单

ex.s: “You have to organize the activities of the children and take care of the bills and groceries. ”
ex.t: “你得组织孩子们的活动，还要管账单和杂货。”

ex.s: What does Donna offer to do for Bill?
ex.t: Donna主动提出为Bill做什么？

ex.s: This brief visit with Mother Nature cost me two days off from work, recovering from a bad case of sunburn and the doctor’s bill for my son’s food poisoning.
ex.t: 这次与大自然的短暂接触让我请了两天假，还因为严重的晒伤和儿子食物中毒的医药费而恢复了好一阵子。

ex.s: But at Union Station in Los Angeles last month, a board went up with dollar bills attached to it with pins and a sign that read, "Give What You Can, Take What You Need."
ex.t: 但上个月在洛杉矶的联合车站，立起了一块板，上面用图钉钉着美元钞票，还有一块牌子写着：“能给多少给多少，需要多少拿多少。”

ex.s: "We even had a bride in her wedding dress come up to the board and take a few dollars." Most of the bills on the board were singles, but a few people left fives, tens and even twenties.
ex.t: “我们甚至有一位穿着婚纱的新娘走到板前拿了几美元。”板上的钞票大多是1美元，但有几个人留下了5美元、10美元甚至20美元。

defs.def: a written suggestion for a new law that is presented to a country's parliament so that its members can discuss it （提交议会讨论的）议案，法案

ex.s: If the Textalyzer bill becomes law, he said, "people are going to be more afraid to put their hands on the cell phone."
ex.t: 他说，如果Textalyzer法案成为法律，“人们会更不敢把手放在手机上。”

defs.def: a programme of entertainment at a theatre, etc. （剧院等的）节目单
a notice in a public place to advertise an event 海报；招贴；广告
the hard pointed or curved outer part of a bird's mouth 鸟嘴；喙
having the type of bill mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: Bill Shankly(1913-1981) was one of Britain's most successful and respected football managers.
ex.t: 比尔·香克利（1913-1981）是英国最成功、最受尊敬的足球经理之一。

ex.s: This ordinary-looking man was Bill Cunningham, one of the most important American photographers of the last 50 years.
ex.t: 这个相貌平平的老人就是比尔·坎宁安，过去50年来美国最重要的摄影师之一。
